title: The Hay Wagon Comes Home
synopsis: Adults load the little square bales onto the hay wagon, Farmer Ruth drives around by the farm lane, and Molly finally visits Rex at Pine Park.
continuity_state: Before: Small rectangular bales have been made in the hayfield but have not yet been gathered. The low hay wagon waits by the red barn. Molly has not yet visited Pine Park. After: Adults collect and stack hay bales in a dry covered section of the red barn on supports off the ground; the hayfield harvest is complete for now. Ruth's red tractor and low wagon return to their farm places. Molly visits Pine Park with Farmer Ruth for the first time, sees Pancake Hill and meets Rex there as a visitor.
